programs.title: Jhanak
programs.desc: Determined to fulfill her mother's dream of a better life, a young woman faces numerous trials and personal loss, only to have her journey further complicated by a man she meets along the way. Hiba Nawab, Krushal Ahuja.

programs.title: Love By Force
programs.desc: Naitik and Akshara are forced to marry, while love brings Kartik and Naira together, revealing the difference between love-based relationships and forced marriage. Hina Khan, Karan Mehra.

programs.title: Melodies Of The Heart
programs.desc: A determined mother refuses to bow to the rigid expectations and barriers imposed by society, choosing instead to carve out a path where her daughter's dreams can take flight. Parth Samthaan, Rishita Kothari.

programs.title: I Hate Luv Storys
programs.desc: Bollywood Art Director, Simran is in love with her childhood friend, but when she meets Jay, she leaves her man for him. As soon she realizes that he does not appreciate love,though she returns to her old man again.Would Jay regret his loss of Simran ? Imran Khan, Sonam Kapoor, Sammir Dattani, Samir Soni, Kavin Dave, Punit Malhotra, Vishal Dadlani.

programs.title: Bheed
programs.desc: A police officer faces challenges in preventing migrant workers from crossing the border, but his role becomes a noble battle for human compassion. Rajkummar Rao, Pankaj Kapur, Bhumi Pednekar, Aditya Srivastava, Kritika Kamra, Anubhav Sinha, Anubhav Sinha.

programs.title: Finding Fanny
programs.desc: A man embarks on a road trip to find his lost love. Deepika Padukone, Arjun Kapoor, Naseeruddin Shah, Dimple Kapadia, Anjali Patil, Homi Adajania, Homi Adajania, Kersi Khambatta.
